kicker: Intern-S2, a model built for science

scenes.headline: How a science model reads the raw page
scenes.sub: Intern-S2: raw-page pretraining, a dynamic tokenizer and multi-domain RL.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Waltz! Intern-S2 is a three-hundred-ninety-seven-billion-parameter model built for one thing: science. Three design choices get it there.

scenes.text: Push science into the model itself: read raw pages without parsing, tokenize molecules and proteins as real units, and train every science domain together.
scenes.say: Push science into the model itself. Read raw pages without parsing them, tokenize molecules and proteins as real units, and train the science domains together.

steps.say: A normal pipeline flattens a page to text first: OCR the words, guess the order, drop the figures. Intern-S2 skips all that.
A vision encoder maps the text, figures and equations into one shared space.
Two heads read that same space, one for symbolic meaning and one for visual relations. So a plot and the sentence citing it become one object.

left.title: Subword tokenizer
items: Aspirin's ring smeared across three tokens
Amino acids merged into meaningless chunks
left.say: An ordinary tokenizer splits a molecule wherever its text statistics say. Aspirin's ring gets smeared across three tokens.

right.title: Dynamic tokenizer
items: An atom, a bond or a residue per token
The model can attend to one residue cleanly
right.say: Intern-S2's dynamic tokenizer makes each atom, bond, residue or waveform sample its own token, so the model can attend to it cleanly.

items.say: Post-training runs reinforcement learning across more than twenty science domains.
All of them jointly, in one model, not one per task.
Rewarding careful, multi-step reasoning in every domain also lifts general reasoning.

scenes.title: Specialized science: leads by multiples
scenes.note: MP20 is internal; on general tasks it is parity, not conquest
scenes.say: On general tasks, it sits at frontier parity. On specialized science, it leads by multiples: fifty-six point nine two on multi-omics, where the next best manages thirteen point eight seven.

scenes.text: The specialization is the product: science lives in the tokenizer and the pretraining objective, not in a fine-tune.
scenes.say: The specialization is the product. Science lives in the tokenizer and the pretraining objective, not in a fine-tune bolted on at the end.

recap: Pretrain on raw pages, figures included
Tokenize atoms, residues and samples natively
Train 20+ science domains jointly with RL
scenes.say: To recap: read the raw page, tokenize science natively, and train the domains together.
